page.overview:
Who is Charles de la Tête d'Or III?

Charles de la Tête d'Or III, more simply Charles III, is the King of Bretonnia in the alternate timeline of Warhammer Fantasy Battle that existed prior to its 4th Edition change in the lore of Bretonnia.

Bretonnian society in that alternate timeline was falling into ruin, as a national apathy had set in and given rise to corruption, inefficiency and decay. The Bretonnian aristocracy looked only to its own pleasures while the unruly mob of peasants starved amidst the worst squalor in the Old World.

King Charles III is a cruel, vain, and despotic ruler from Oisillon, the capital of Bretonnia. The King intended to conduct a plundering raid over the border with the southern nation of Estalia. But the campaign drew to a muddy close. His ragtag army then headed back over the Bretonnian border in search of new volunteers.

Charles III was the son of Charles II and grandson of Charles I.
